endosymbiosis-steps.alt: Four panels. 1: a host cell with a nucleus wraps its membrane around a bacterium that uses oxygen. 2: the bacterium lives inside the host, surrounded by two membranes, its own and one from the host, with its own circular DNA. 3: the bacterium's descendants have become mitochondria that divide by splitting in two. 4: in one line of these cells a photosynthetic bacterium was later taken in and became the chloroplast.
